definitions.explanation: The angular distance of a place north or south of the earth's equator, measured in degrees. Used in geography and navigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緯度|いど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{北緯|ほくい}→北緯：noentry⟧35⟦{度|ど}→度：noentry⟧⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧だ。
examples.english: Tokyo's latitude is around 35 degrees north.

examples.japanese: {緯度|いど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ほど⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The higher the latitude, the colder it gets.

examples.japanese: {緯度|いど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経度|けいど}→経度：00209_keido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定：04275_tokutei⟧。
examples.english: To specify a location using latitude and longitude.

notes:
{緯度|いど} is a geography term for latitude — the angular distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{北緯|ほくい}→北緯：noentry⟧: north latitude
- ⟦{南緯|なんい}→南緯：noentry⟧: south latitude
- {緯度|いど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high latitude (closer to poles)
- {緯度|いど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low latitude (closer to equator)
- {緯度|いど}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{経度|けいど}→経度：00209_keido⟧: latitude and longitude

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{緯|い}→緯：noentry⟧ (weft, latitude) + ⟦{度|ど}→度：noentry⟧ (degree). The character {緯|い} originally refers to horizontal threads in weaving, extended to mean the east-west lines on a globe.

CONTRAST:
- {緯度|いど}: latitude (north-south position)
- ⟦{経度|けいど}→経度：00209_keido⟧: longitude (east-west position)

HOMOPHONE:
⟦{井戸|いど}→井戸：03977_ido⟧ (well) has the same reading but completely different meaning and kanji.
